Accept actively registered relationship kinds in SDK and CLI dependency mutations

GitHub 1452 reports that registerRelationshipKinds activation succeeds, but create/update dependency assignments still refuse custom kinds through a built-in vocabulary. This blocks downstream package-defined ordering edges despite graph registry support. Reproduce in an isolated installed extension and align mutation validation, aliases and diagnostics with the active workspace registry.

Use a real isolated extension to prove create/update and SDK writes plus graph traversal for a custom ordering kind; validate aliases and cardinality/cycle semantics through the authoritative active registry; deactivated or absent registrations refuse before item/history mutation; an independent pre-fix control fails; complete source coverage, SDK contracts and installed Node/Bun consumers pass.
CLI and SDK dependency writes accept active registered kinds and aliases while refusing inactive or unknown kinds with precise recovery.
